data.description:
Camunda is the enterprise platform for agentic orchestration, enabling organizations to coordinate AI agents, people, and systems across complex, end-to-end business processes. With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide, including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences.

Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform. We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team.

Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies, We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading.

About the Role

At Camunda, we're transforming the way enterprises orchestrate AI and automate their most critical business processes—and we're just getting started. As a Corporate Account Executive, you'll join a fast-growing sales team and be at the forefront of helping mid-sized organizations break through the automation ceiling by orchestrating AI agents, people, and systems at scale.

We're witnessing a pivotal moment: enterprises are deploying AI agents faster than ever, but they're struggling to coordinate them safely and achieve end-to-end outcomes. That's where Camunda comes in. You'll work with curious, collaborative, and highly motivated people who believe in doing great work without ego. This is a role where your contributions will have a visible impact—not only on your customers' success, but on how they operationalize AI across their entire organization.

What You Will Do

  • Drive the full sales cycle—from initial outreach to negotiation and close—with prospects in the corporate segment (typically organizations with under $1B in revenue).

  • Partner closely with marketing, partner teams, sales development, and customer success to create compelling customer journeys that turn interest into adoption.

  • Position Camunda's unique approach to agentic orchestration- building strong relationships with technical leaders, line-of-business executives, and decision-makers through in-person and virtual settings.

  • Accurately forecast, generate / manage pipeline, and consistently meet or exceed quota goals with integrity.

  • Become a trusted advisor by deeply understanding each prospect's automation goals, the gaps they face with current tools, and how Camunda helps scale agentic orchestration across their entire business.

  • Collaborate with colleagues across the business to share learnings, improve our sales playbook, and strengthen how we talk about agentic orchestration in the market.

What You Will Bring to the Role

  • 3+ years of quota-carrying experience in complex B2B SaaS sales, closing deals in the $50k - $250k range.

  • Proven success managing a full sales cycle, from prospecting through close.

  • Ability to clearly communicate complex value to both technical and business stakeholders—from CTOs concerned with governance and scale to line-of-business leaders focused on outcomes.

  • Strong pipeline management and forecasting discipline.

  • A growth mindset, high integrity, and a collaborative spirit aligned with Camunda's values.

  • Ability and/or willingness to use our product.

This role is an existing vacancy

##LI-AG1 #LI-Remote #USEAST #USWEST

What We Have to Offer:

Compensation

We offer competitive, fair, and transparent compensation. Salary ranges are location-based, with Standard and Major markets (global tech hubs) reflecting local competition.

The Annual Total Target Cash (base salary + 100% variable target, where applicable) shown below spans from the minimum in a Standard market to the maximum in a Major market. Final offers depend on skills, experience, and location, and we typically hire in the first half of the range to allow room for growth:

  • United States: $212,700.00 to $343,000.00

  • United Kingdom: £133,500.00 to £219,700.00

  • Singapore: S$264,200.00 to S$396,200.00

  • Canada: C$225,800 to C$371,500

If you’re based elsewhere, you’ll be hired via Remote.com (our global employer partner), and your Talent Acquisition Partner will provide a personalized Total Rewards Calculator after your first interview.

Equity: We also offer equity (where applicable) through our Virtual Stock Option Plan (VSOP).

Benefits & Perks

We invest in your wellbeing, growth, and ability to connect, along with perks that support you no matter where you’re based. Our benefits are globally designed and locally delivered where applicable.

  • Remote & Flexible: Work from anywhere with the setup that suits you, home office budget, co-working space support, and flexible time off to recharge when you need it.

  • In Person Connection: We invest in meaningful face time through our Annual Kickoff (Vienna in 2025, Madrid in 2026!), team offsites, and Camundi Connection Budgets, including contributing to meetups while travelling,, and local gatherings with fellow Camundi.

  • Health & Wellbeing: Access locally tailored healthcare, Modern Health for global mental wellbeing, and our Live Well Lifestyle Spending Account (LSA), a flexible, global benefit that puts you in control of your whole life, not just work, from: staying active, to caring for family, exploring personal passions, meaningful experiences, and investing in your financial wellbeing. The Live Well program launches in 2026 and scales to €1,000 annually from 2027.

  • Financial Security: Retirement and pension plans (often with company contributions), plus life and disability insurance where relevant.

  • Professional Growth: Up to $/€/£1,000 per year for self-driven learning: courses, certifications, books, you decide!

AI in our hiring process: Camunda may use AI tools to aid the screening of applications and during the interview process. You can learn more here

”Everyone is welcome at Camunda” — it’s a celebrated component of our culture. We strive to create an inclusive environment that empowers our people. At Camunda, we honour diverse cultures and backgrounds and are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to gender, race, ethnicity, religion, belief, sexual orientation, age, disability or any other protected characteristics under applicable law. We are looking forward to your application!

Come join us and be part of Camunda’s incredible journey: Make an impact at a pivotal moment in our story!

Please be aware that scammers may impersonate Camunda by reaching out about job opportunities. Camunda will only contact candidates from an email address ending in @camunda.com or @talent.camunda.com. We will never ask candidates for bank account details, checks, payment, or other sensitive financial information as part of our hiring process. If you receive a suspicious message, please do not respond, click any links, or share personal information.

Note for recruiting and placement agencies: Camunda does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our careers site, employees, or any other Camunda contact unless we have specifically engaged your firm for that search. Camunda will not pay fees related to unsolicited resumes.

About the Role

Hi there! We're hiring an Enterprise Account Executive III to join our Sales team.

Our sales team is tenured, technically curious, and genuinely invested in doing right by the customer, not just closing the deal in front of them. We partner closely across the business, and we operate with a lot of trust: you're given real ownership over your territory, and you're expected to bring your own judgment to how you build it.

This role carries real weight. You'll be responsible for a book of enterprise accounts where the deals are complex, the buying committees are large, and the technical bar is high. There's meaningful room here to shape how your territory gets built, not just execute against someone else's plan.

As an Enterprise Account Executive III, you'll own the full sales cycle for enterprise accounts, from first conversation through negotiation and close, working alongside sales engineering, customer success, and leadership to get complex deals across the line. This role matters because enterprise wins are how Camunda grows its footprint in large, strategic accounts, and how we prove the platform works at scale.

What You Will Do

  • Own and execute the full sales cycle for enterprise accounts, from prospecting through negotiation and close.

  • Build and drive strategic account plans that identify whitespace, map stakeholders, and set a realistic path to close.

  • Navigate complex, multi-stakeholder buying committees, including technical, business, and executive buyers.

data.description:
Our goal is to have a solar system on every roof, a storage unit in every house, and an electric car in every garage. Enpal makes this possible with an integrated total solution for decentralized energy—from solar systems and battery storage to wall boxes, smart meters, and heat pumps. At the heart of it all is our AI-powered platform Enpal.One+, which intelligently connects thousands of systems and efficiently optimizes electricity procurement and feed-in on the energy market.

Are you ready for solutions that are more than just a promise and bring real quality of life to thousands of households every day? What you create at Enpal will deliver clean electricity tomorrow and bring about lasting change in how we use energy.

What you’ll do

As Expert Technical Accounting (f/m/x) you will take ownership of complex technical accounting matters across the Group, advise senior Finance and business stakeholders, and help shape Enpal’s accounting policies, governance and financial reporting.

  • You take independent ownership of complex technical accounting topics and workstreams, partnering closely with the Head of Technical Accounting and senior Finance stakeholders.

  • You assess new business models, products, transactions and contractual arrangements under IFRS and HGB and develop robust, well-supported accounting conclusions for complex and judgmental matters.

  • You act as a trusted accounting advisor to Finance and business stakeholders, translating complex business developments into clear accounting implications and practical solutions.

  • You drive the implementation of technical accounting conclusions into accounting and reporting processes, working closely with GL Accounting, Group Accounting, ERP, Tax, Legal and other relevant functions.

What you’ll bring

  • You have a degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration or a comparable field and several years of senior-level experience in Technical Accounting, Accounting Advisory, Group Accounting or Audit, ideally in a complex international organization.

  • You have excellent knowledge of IFRS and HGB and strong practical experience applying accounting standards to complex and judgmental transactions.

  • You have a proven track record of independently developing accounting conclusions and preparing high-quality technical accounting papers, assessments and audit documentation.

  • You communicate confidently in English; German is a strong advantage, particularly for HGB-related topics and statutory audits. A professional qualification such as ACCA, CPA, Wirtschaftsprüfer or equivalent is a plus.

 
 

Are you interested even if you don't meet all the requirements? Apply anyway! We look forward to discovering your potential, regardless of whether your experience meets every single requirement. ☀️

 

What we offer

  • Work at Germany's first green unicorn - Play an active role in shaping the solar energy transition.

  • The sun shines all over the world - At Enpal, you'll work with a highly motivated, diverse team of over 65 nationalities.

  • The ideal setup for your focus - We are convinced that excellent results are achieved when the conditions are right. That's why we rely on a hybrid working concept that gives you the freedom to always work in the way that best suits your tasks. Do you need new inspiration on an international level? With Workflex, we offer you the opportunity to relocate abroad for up to 30 days a year, depending on your responsibilities.

  • Grown-up business & startup spirit - In our modern office in Berlin-Friedrichshain, you'll find everything your heart desires, from height-adjustable desks and table tennis to stocked beverage fridges and barista coffee.

  • Your kick-start at Enpal - Onboarding day with a welcome bag, buddy program, and a team that really supports you.

  • Stay up to date & help shape the future - Transparent all-hands meetings, short decision-making processes, and an open feedback culture - without mistakes, there is no progress.

  • The energy transition can only be achieved together - At Enpal, you can expect legendary team spirit and unforgettable team events.

  • Your extra boost - 29 vacation days + one additional day off on Christmas Eve and New Year's Eve, discounted membership at Wellhub, and corporate benefits. Everything you need to help you achieve a good work-life balance.

 

At Enpal, we are proud of the diversity of our team. No decisions are made on the basis of skin colour, religion or religious belief, ethnic or national origin, nationality, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability or age, either during recruitment or employment. Enpal stands for a safe workplace and takes action against discrimination and harassment of any kind.

data.title: (Junior) Operations Manager – Process Excellence & Automation (w/m/d)

data.description:
Our goal is to have a solar system on every roof, a storage unit in every house, and an electric car in every garage. Enpal makes this possible with an integrated total solution for decentralized energy—from solar systems and battery storage to wall boxes, smart meters, and heat pumps. At the heart of it all is our AI-powered platform Enpal.One+, which intelligently connects thousands of systems and efficiently optimizes electricity procurement and feed-in on the energy market.

Omniwatt Energy GmbH is Enpal’s electricity division, making clean energy accessible to every household—from Germany’s most affordable electricity rates to smart energy solutions that optimally integrate generation, storage, and consumption.

With ambitious growth targets and a rapidly expanding customer base, we are building a team that is actively shaping the German energy market. In doing so, we combine startup agility with the scale of a market leader—across all areas, from operations and technology to finance, customer support, and product development.

 

What you'll do:

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer (f/m/x) to take end-to-end ownership of building and scaling our core product systems. You'll design and implement reliable services across our stack, integrate with external platforms and teams, and own the full lifecycle from idea to deployment. You'll also help shape our technical direction and mentor other engineers.

  • Build and own complex solutions end-to-end, collaborating with your team and stakeholders to deliver product features that solve real user problems.

  • Design scalable backend services with NestJS/Node.js, create frontend experiences with Next.js/React, and architect data models with MongoDB.

  • Leverage your strong infrastructure expertise to design, deploy, and operate reliable cloud-native solutions in Azure.

  • Build and consume APIs, integrating with internal and external systems while collaborating with and guiding other engineering teams.

  • Own your deployments, build CI/CD pipelines, manage infrastructure as code, and maintain applications in production.

  • Drive code quality through testing, code reviews, and continuous integration, setting standards for the team.

  • Monitor systems, optimize performance, troubleshoot complex issues, and make architectural decisions for scalability.

  • Mentor mid-level and junior engineers, foster a culture of clean code and best practices, and lead by example in technical discussions.

 

What you'll bring:

  • Strong experience delivering end-to-end software solutions and driving technical excellence.

  • Strong proficiency in TypeScript and Node.js, or solid experience with other modern languages and willingness to learn our stack.

  • Solid hands-on experience working with IT infrastructure, cloud environments, and system architecture. Experience with Microsoft Azure is a strong plus.

  • Strong experience working with MongoDB or other NoSQL databases, including schema design and optimization.

  • Proven track record building and consuming APIs, with experience leading cross-team integrations.

  • Demonstrated ability to own projects from conception through deployment and maintenance.

  • Strong commitment to code quality, testing strategies, and building systems that scale.

  • Experience mentoring or leading other engineers.

 

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with Next.js and NestJS specifically.

  • Hands-on experience with infrastructure as code tools (Terraform, Pulumi, etc.).

  • Strong experience building CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, etc.).

  • Experience with containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes).

  • Experience with monitoring, observability, and performance optimization tools.

  • Experience designing system architecture for high-scale applications.

 

Our Engineering Culture value engineers who:

  • Take end-to-end ownership of their work.

  • Care deeply about code quality and testing.

  • Embrace responsibility for the full lifecycle of their applications—from development through production.

  • Collaborate effectively across teams and communicate clearly about technical decisions

  • Think about scalability and long-term system design.

  • Lead by example and help grow the skills of those around them.

Are you interested even if you don't meet all the requirements? Apply anyway! We look forward to discovering your potential—regardless of whether your experience meets every single requirement. ☀️

What we offer:

  • Work at Germany's first green unicorn - Play an active role in shaping the solar energy transition.

  • The sun shines all over the world - At Enpal, you'll work with a highly motivated, diverse team of over 65 nationalities.

  • The ideal setup for your focus - We are convinced that excellent results are achieved when the conditions are right. That's why we rely on a hybrid working concept that gives you the freedom to always work in the way that best suits your tasks. Do you need new inspiration on an international level? With Workflex, we offer you the opportunity to relocate abroad for up to 30 days a year, depending on your responsibilities.

  • Grown-up business & startup spirit - In our modern office in Berlin-Friedrichshain, you'll find everything your heart desires, from height-adjustable desks and table tennis to stocked beverage fridges and barista coffee.

  • Your kick-start at Enpal - Onboarding day with a welcome bag, buddy program, and a team that really supports you.

  • Stay up to date & help shape the future - Transparent all-hands meetings, short decision-making processes, and an open feedback culture - without mistakes, there is no progress.

  • The energy transition can only be achieved together - At Enpal, you can expect legendary team spirit and unforgettable team events.

  • Your extra boost - 29 + 2 vacation days, discounted membership at Wellhub, and corporate benefits. Everything you need to help you achieve a good work-life balance.

At Enpal, we are proud of the diversity of our team. No decisions are made on the basis of skin colour, religion or religious belief, ethnic or national origin, nationality, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability or age, either during recruitment or employment. Enpal stands for a safe workplace and takes action against discrimination and harassment of any kind.

What we would love to see from you

About Linro

Linro is a cloud security company building a real-time, agentic cloud-security platform. Teams ship with AI. AI ships with Linro.

Cloud infrastructure changes constantly, and increasingly it's AI agents making those changes, not people. Most security tools only catch problems after the fact. Linro works differently. We enforce what's allowed at every stage, from commit to production. We stop bad changes before they ship, and fix problems in real time once they're live.

We have each been on the receiving end of this problem: running cloud security at scale, building the platforms underneath it, and shipping in regulated systems where a wrong change isn't an option. Founded in Berlin in 2026 and built fully remote across Europe, Linro has a platform that's real and working, with plenty still to shape.

The role

You will own Linro's security and compliance program end to end, starting from a blank page. Your job is to build that from scratch: figure out where we actually stand, find the gaps, and close them across a multi-cloud environment. Automate what can be automated instead of redoing the same work by hand every quarter.

What you will do

  • Take SOC2, ISO 27001 and 42001 from a blank page to audit-ready. Run the gap analysis, document controls and policies, gather and map evidence, track remediation to done, and get us through audit.

  • Automate compliance instead of just babysitting it: build checks and guardrails so we stay continuously compliant, and help ensure our multi-cloud infrastructure (AWS and beyond) is managed as Infrastructure-as-Code with Terraform.

  • Own our compliance evidence end to end: keep it current, mapped, and audit-ready across whatever tooling we run.

  • Support security operations: monitoring, alert triage, and documenting findings.

  • Stay close to how the product is actually built. Our compliance checks run on the same engine we sell customers, so you are testing the product, not filling out paperwork off to the side.

What we are looking for

  • Hands-on experience with at least one of SOC 2, ISO 27001, or ISO 42001: you have run a gap analysis, built and mapped evidence, and taken a program through an actual audit, not just studied the framework. Experience across more than one is a plus.

  • Genuine interest in cloud and information security, governance, and compliance, and the drive to own outcomes, not just tasks.

  • Comfort reading cloud configurations and IaC across multiple providers. Ability to automate scales with level.

We are remote across Europe and hire anywhere within roughly two hours of Central European Time (CEST). We get the whole team together in person somewhere in Europe once a quarter for a few days. We work async by default, write things down, and protect people's focus time.

data.description:
We are building the first AI-native platform for automated product compliance in MedTech. REMATIQ turn hundreds of page of complex regulations (like MDR and FDA guidance) into structured, actionable requirements that plug directly into our customers’ development and quality processes. The result: life‑saving medical devices reach patients faster and safer.

About the job

As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you build software with and for our customers. Existing customers ask for more than the standard product does. They want further use cases, integrations with their own systems and workflows specific to their organisation. You sit with the customer's team, scope the problem and build the solution end to end. It runs at the customer as custom software or becomes a feature of the REMATIQ web app.

This is a software engineering role with customer contact, not a consulting role. You work closely with our AI Deployment Strategists, Product and the platform team.

We believe in the value of in-person collaboration and work in a hybrid setup, with the team coming together in our office in the heart of Berlin-Mitte typically four days per week.

How you'll contribute

  • Scope with the customer: Sit with their project team and subject-matter experts, understand the workflow and its constraints, and cut the problem into something that can ship in weeks.

  • Build and ship end to end: Design, develop and deploy the solution, including backend services, integrations, AI workflows and the interface it needs.

  • Run what you shipped: Operate it in production, fix what breaks, and be the customer's technical contact for it.

  • Build integrations: Connect REMATIQ to the systems customers already use in their development and quality processes.

  • Move custom work into the product: Build features in the web app and work with the platform team to turn one customer's solution into a product capability.

  • Find the next use case: Spot further use cases while you work with the customer and scope them together with Delivery.

Our stack

We work in a modern TypeScript‑first monorepo:

  • Core: Node.js 20+, TypeScript 5+, pnpm workspaces, Turborepo.

  • Frontend: React (Vite), Tailwind CSS, and design system.

  • Backend & workflows: Express-based services, with DBOS for durable workflows.

  • Data & storage: PostgreSQL with pgvector, Prisma ORM, Azure Blob Storage.

  • AI & observability: Azure OpenAI, Langfuse, Sentry, plus logging/tracing with tools like Winston and OpenTelemetry.

  • Dev experience: AI‑assisted workflows with Cursor and Claude Code, integrated into our TypeScript‑first monorepo and review process.

What you'll bring

We are looking for a software engineer who ships production software and is equally at home in a customer's meeting room.

You may be a strong fit if you have:

  • Relevant background: 3+ years as a software engineer shipping production software, ideally including forward deployed, solutions engineering or other customer-facing engineering work.

  • Product management or team lead experience: Some experience as a product manager or team lead, where you owned scope, priorities and requirements for what is being built, is a strong plus.

  • Strong TypeScript and Node.js backend experience: You build and operate production services and can contribute to React frontends where needed.

  • Solid database fundamentals: PostgreSQL (ideally), including data modelling, migrations and performance.

  • Integration experience: You have connected a product to enterprise systems through APIs, SSO or data exchange, and have worked within a customer's IT and security constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs: You have put LLM-driven features into production and know how to make them predictable and reviewable.

  • Strong customer presence: You scope a problem with non-technical stakeholders, explain technical trade-offs clearly, and manage expectations without a project manager next to you.

  • AI-native working style: You use Claude Code or Cursor every day to move faster without compromising reliability.

  • High ownership: You take an ambiguous customer problem to production with limited guidance.

  • Willingness to travel: You work on site at customers when the project needs it.

  • Fluency in English (mandatory). German is a strong plus.

We'll be especially excited if you

  • Have worked as a forward deployed or customer-embedded engineer

  • Have built software for a regulated industry such as MedTech or pharma.

  • Have been a founder or a very early engineer at a startup.

    Why this is a great opportunity

  • Impact in a high-stakes domain – Work on compliance workflows in one of the most regulated industries, where correctness and traceability matter and the outcomes are real.

  • Bring GenAI into production – Build the systems that make LLM-driven features predictable, auditable, and reliable in safety-critical MedTech environments.

  • Real ownership – Own major parts of our platform and drive architectural decisions across backend services, workflows, and data.

  • AI‑agent‑first development – Build in an environment where tools like Cursor and Claude Code are first‑class citizens, helping you explore designs, refactor, and ship faster while you stay in control of quality and reliability.

  • Strong peers – Work with people who care deeply about craft and outcomes, in a high-ownership culture that includes teammates with founder experience.

  • Work with leading MedTech companies – Build products used by teams at BBraun, Novartis & Bayer.

Location: 100% remote (EMEA, CET±2), with team gatherings in person a few times a year
Hours: Full-time, 40 hours per week
Pay: €60.000 to €90.000 annually, adjusted by experience and location

At Miaplaza, we build homeschool platforms that kids aged 4–18 actually want to use — Miacademy, MiaPrep, and our Online High School are serving over 150.000 students today. Our product foundations are strong. What we want next is a step change in how our products feel: more expressive illustration, more purposeful motion, more moments of craft that turn a lesson into something a kid remembers.

We're hiring a Senior Product Designer whose craft anchor is illustration and motion. Our design team is small and senior, five designers when you join, and each brings a distinct strength: brand, design systems, research, and now yours

The role

You'd own product design for the student learning experience end-to-end: from problem framing through delivery, in a Product Trio with a PM and EM who have strong opinions and expect yours. This is product work with real trade-offs — pedagogical, technical, and business — and you're accountable for how it lands, not just how it looks.

Beyond Curriculum, you'd set the illustration and motion bar for all of Miaplaza: the standards, motion principles, and character direction that the other designers and the design system build from.

A defining part of the role is art-directing AI-assisted production. You'd build the prompts, references, and review process that let a small team produce quality illustration and motion at a scale hand-crafting alone can't reach. We don't expect you to know every current tool — we expect the taste and judgment to direct output rather than accept defaults.

You'd report to the Head of UX, with regular 1:1s covering craft, product, and career growth. The direction is upward: deeper craft leadership, cross-product influence, or both.


You must have all of these to be considered:

  • A portfolio of shipped digital product work — not only concepts or standalone pieces

  • At least 2 years working as a product designer or a UI/UX designer inside a product team, collaborating with PMs and engineers

  • Strong illustration or motion skills, with at least 1 year focused on either as a primary craft

  • Proficiency in Figma

  • Some experience directing or guiding visual work produced by others — freelancers, junior designers, or AI tools

You’ll stand out if you also have:

  • Deep motion skills in product contexts: interactions, transitions, onboarding, character animation

  • Experience using AI image or motion tools as production accelerators

  • Confidence running your own usability research, not just receiving findings

  • Multi-brand or education-focused design experience

  • Accessibility practice, especially for neurodivergent audiences

This probably isn’t right for you if:

  • Your work hasn't yet lived inside a live product with real constraints

  • You prefer well-scoped tasks over shaping ambiguous problems

  • You see AI tools as either a threat to craft or a shortcut around it

Our hiring process

As a remote company, we receive a large number of applicants, and finding the best fit for this role is our top priority — that’s why our process is longer than usual. At every stage, we try to be respectful of your time and grateful you’re spending it with us.

  1. Application and eligibility check — work authorization, timezone, availability

  2. Async assessment — 12 scenario-based, multiple-choice questions (~30 min) + when qualifying; 3 open questions (max. 45 min)

    1. If you pass the multiple choice section, you will asked to complete 3 open written questions (max. 45 min)

  3. Portfolio review — the design team will review your best work and thinking

  4. Behavioral interview — a conversation with our People team about how you work

  5. Take-home design task — ~120 minutes, scoped for this role, AI tools encouraged

  6. Hiring team interview — with a design team member and the Head of UX

  7. Skip-level conversation — with executive leadership

  8. Reference checks

We give honest, timely feedback at every step. Job searches are hard; we don't want to make yours harder.

Compensation and setup

The pay range for this role is €60,000 - 90,000. Miaplaza’s compensation philosophy ensures equity and competitiveness while considering regional differences in labor costs. Placement within a range is determined based on factors such as demonstrated skills, internal equity, and local labor market rates for the candidate’s geographic area.

Miaplaza is a growing, self-funded EdTech company. We're an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds. If you need accommodations at any point in the process, just let us know.

ABOUT OUR COMPANY 

We are an engineering organization. Our mission is to “Ship great software” and build custom, large-scale software platforms on time, on budget, on target and on quality. 

In over two decades, we have never failed to deliver what we promised. 

85% of our members are software engineers with a background in computer science, physics or mathematics, many also with a strong background in Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence.

freiheit.com technologies was founded in Hamburg in the midst of the first internet boom in the last millennium in 1999.

Since then, we’ve been building custom software platforms and helping our clients to create their future business models based on software.

For over a quarter of a century, we have been working for the "Who's Who" of German and European industry and business.
Retail, automotive, e-commerce, healthcare and more.

Our large-scale software platforms are used by millions of users every day. Each product has a business-critical, strategic relevance for our clients.

Together we make “mission impossible” possible.

We are a team of 300+ members with people from all over the world. In our engineering hubs in Hamburg and Lisbon we come together to create things that no one has built before.

Our teams work data-driven to constantly optimize their own productivity by removing friction from their work. Each member takes on end-to-end responsibility for their work. To be successful, you need to be productive. To be productive, you need to be efficient and effective.

Technology never rests. Neither do we.



ABOUT THE JOB

  • Your responsibility: From day one, you’ll own your stories and take end-to-end responsibility for your tasks. 

  • Your team: You'll work in a small team of no more than five full-stack engineers. Like this, our teams are more efficient and can move fast.

  • Your work: You’ll be involved in the entire software engineering lifecycle of your project - from product requirements and design to testing, deployment and operations. You’ll see how people actually use what you build and continuously improve it based on user feedback and real usage data.

  • Your projects: We partner with clients across all industries who trust us with their most challenging software problems. We take full ownership from the first idea to the final roll-out. You’re not joining a client team as an extra pair of hands - you’re part of the team responsible for solving the problem. We don’t do body leasing.

  • Your impact: You will contribute to some of the largest, business-critical and most demanding software projects in Europe.

  • Your perspective: No matter your experience, everyone starts as a newbie and passes through all of our engineering levels. From owning small to medium feature sets to being responsible for the whole codebase. Here you can learn how to build and run large-scale software systems – and grow into a full-stack software engineer. 

  • Your community: You’ll work with smart, like-minded people who care about what they do and the people around them. With over 300 people across our Hamburg and Lisbon hubs, we work hard, support each other, and make sure to create a work environment where you can become the best version of yourself. 

    • We are a company for engineers by engineers. Most of your time is spent solving problems with like-minded people, writing software and working together with your team in our beautiful offices in the heart of Hamburg & Lisbon.  

    We expect a lot. It's not easy. But we guarantee you it will be fun.



    ABOUT YOU

    Qualifications:

  • A degree: Bachelor's, Master's or PhD in Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics or a closely related field. 
  • Problem solving: We hire our members for their problem-solving abilities, not specific programming languages. We value strong engineering fundamentals, analytical thinking, and the ability to turn complex ideas into working code. We believe: if you know how to code, debug, and solve complex problems, you can learn any language. We hire smart engineers, not language specialists.
  • A genuine curiosity for programming: Whether through interesting pet projects, hackathons, competitive programming.
  • A habit of stepping outside your comfort zone: Whether through competitive tutoring, scholarships, or even competitive sports, anything else where you pushed yourself and grew from it.

    • Bonus skills or interests:

  • Algorithms and data structures, understanding time & space complexity

  • Experience in Go, Kotlin, TypeScript or JavaScript

  • Experience in front end development, like ReactJS, Angular, Vue or Flutter/Dart

  • Functional programming with Common Lisp, Clojure or Haskell

  • Experience working with distributed systems in the Cloud

  • Experience in Machine Learning and Data Science 



    • OUR HIRING PROCESS

    From reviewing your CV to the final hire, its engineers who are in charge of the recruiting process. Your first interview will be conducted by one of our engineers. No recruiters, no script reading. You’ll talk directly with the engineers you’ll be building alongside, so we can dive straight into real technical problems and our ways of working.  

    ABOUT OUR COMMUNITY 

    If you ask anyone why they work here, it's pretty likely that they will say “because of the people” and “because I've never learned so much in my life”.

    We believe that productive people are happy people. 

    In our engineering hubs in Hamburg and Lisbon, you will meet people from all over the world. 

    Here you have the opportunity to work with intelligent people on interesting tasks and complete projects from idea to operations – end-to-end.

    Becoming a well-rounded professional in your field of expertise is a long journey that takes many years of hard work and learning. Being a member of our company will ask a lot of you and no one can do the work for you.

    Our company is a place where you can become the best version of yourself. 

    ***We don’t provide remote-only positions. We work in the office five days a week. 

     

    WANT TO JOIN US?

    Send us your complete application (CV) via our applicant portal. If you have any questions about your application or the application process, please contact Bianca Mioc personally at +49 40/890584-0.

data.description:
Our Opportunity

Over the past three years, Predium has built the leading real estate intelligence platform for ESG and value management in the DACH region - with the strongest names in the industry as customers: asset managers, housing companies, banks. Our customer base, our data, our credibility - that's valuable capital for the next step. Investment, credit, and asset management decisions in real estate are still made in Excel, case by case. We're now building the AI analyst that takes this work off people's hands - working directly on the customer's own data, scalable without adding headcount. We're well-funded, and we're bringing AI into real estate.


Your Mission

As a Senior Backend Engineer, you own the systems behind our platform: the GraphQL API, the relational data model, the background processing that turns customer documents and spreadsheets into structured data, and the permission model that lets a single owner and a bank with hundreds of portfolios use the same product. Most of your work runs from schema design all the way to the resolver.
You partner with product, design and other engineers to make sure we build what matters - not just what you have been told to do. You take real responsibility for production: when something is slow, you find out why, whether the answer is a bad query, application code or the infrastructure underneath.
You also help us make AI reliable in production. Document extraction, long-running analysis jobs and agentic features are core to where the product is going, and we need people who make these workflows testable and dependable rather than impressive in a demo.
Our company size of ~40 people ensures that the best idea wins and political discussions are kept aside. And every line of code helps to improve the carbon footprint of real estate properties.

Tech stack: TypeScript (NestJS backend, React frontend), Hasura/GraphQL, PostgreSQL (multiple databases incl. PostGIS), queue-based job processing, AWS (ECS / Elastic Beanstalk, S3, SES, Textract), IaC, Claude but all agents welcome


What you'll own

  • Build features across our Hasura GraphQL API, NestJS and Postgres. From schema design to resolver.
  • Model complex real estate and ESG domains in relational schemas. We run several Postgres databases side by side (one of them geospatial), and schema decisions here have consequences but also positive impact.
  • Own background processing: Excel imports, document extraction, long-running analysis jobs, 3D and image processing. Queues, retries, jobs that spawn other jobs - and figuring out what to do when step 3 of 7 fails at 2am.
  • Develop our permission model. Customers range from a single owner to enterprises with organization/portfolio/building-level access.
  • Integrate LLMs into backend workflows - especially document and data extraction - and make them reliable, verifyable and testable.
  • Debug production. Navigate Grafana dashboards and traces to find out why something is slow or failing, whether in the app, the CI/build pipeline or the infrastructure.
  • Spot overgrown or overly complex parts of the codebase and simplify them without being asked. Paying down complexity is part of the job.


What success looks like

  • You have shipped features end-to-end across schema, API and background processing that our customers actively use.
  • Our async processing (imports, extraction, analysis jobs) is measurably more robust: fewer silent failures, clear retry and recovery paths, and observability that tells us what broke and why.
  • You have taken ownership of at least one core area e.g. the permission model, the job orchestration layer or the LLM extraction pipeline and are the person the team goes to for it.
  • You have raised the bar on testing and developer experience in the backend, and other engineers ship faster because of you.
  • You are a trusted sparring partner for product and the team when we decide what to build and how.


What it takes

  • You're strong with Postgres. Schema design comes naturally, you can read a query plan, and you know when the ORM is lying to you. Geospatial experience is a bonus, not a requirement.
  • You're fluent in typed backend TypeScript. We work in NestJS and GraphQL every day; if your experience is in a comparable stack, that's fine, you'll pick it up fast.
  • You've built real queue-based processing. You designed workers, dealt with retries and partial failures, orchestrated multi-step workflows.
  • You've designed or worked with authorization for a multi-tenant product and know where it might get hairy.
  • You'd rather have one integration test that hits a real database schema than ten unit tests mocking everything. You write the test that catches the broken migration.
  • You treat production as a debuggable system. You can navigate dashboards and traces to figure out why something is slow, and you don't treat infrastructure as someone else's problem.
  • You communicate clearly - with engineers, product and, when needed, directly with customers.
  • You speak German at C1 level or better and English fluently. Our customers are German banks and asset managers, and you will talk to them.
Bonus:

  • AWS (S3, SES, ECS, RDS, …) and IaC.

  • LLMs in production, especially document or data extraction and making it reliable for actual user workflows.

  • Data pipeline work: staged, reproducible processing, dataset versioning.

  • Mentoring or leading engineers, or wanting to grow into it.

  • Debugging tooling and build issues, not just application code. Our toolchain moves fast and is occasionally non-standard.


Why Predium?

  • Stage: ~40 people, well-funded, on the way to defining the category. Early enough that a lot still needs to be built. Yes, it's messy sometimes - that's the whole point. If you're looking for a job with a finished playbook, this isn't the right fit.

  • Impact: You're not cog #100 in some company. What you build here runs in production and is what customers rely on every day. Your contribution shows up directly, in revenue and in the product.

  • Ownership: We don't manage your time, we measure your results. You get responsibility and freedom - and the expectation that you'll use both.

  • Compensation: Competitive salary, bonus, and equity. We want you to share in the success you help create.

  • Team: Office-first in Munich's Werksviertel, 4 days/week.
30 vacation days (including company vacation) · Wellpass · Deutschland-Ticket · Jobrad · team events

Als Innovationsinkubator ist das Unternehmen Treiber der Entwicklung von zusätzlichen digitalen Angeboten rund um das Fahrzeug und darüber hinaus. Das Auto entwickelt sich vom reinen Fortbewegungsmittel immer mehr zum Experience Device. Parallel werden die Audi Fahrer_innen immer mehr zum User. data.description:
Über die Stelle

Pflege ist eines der größten gesellschaftlichen Probleme unserer Zeit. marta ist die führende Plattform, die den intransparenten Markt für 24-Stunden-Betreuung radikal verändert. Wir machen Pflege einfacher zugänglich, transparent und bezahlbar.

Wir haben viel ausprobiert und viel gelernt. Performance-Marketing läuft. TV haben wir zwei Jahre lang mit echtem Druck gefahren. Mailing, Print und Partnerschaften kennen wir aus eigener Erfahrung, nicht aus Fallstudien. Jetzt geht es um die zweite Stufe: aus einzelnen Kanälen ein System machen, das trägt, und aus marta eine Marke, die Familien kennen, bevor sie zum ersten Mal suchen.

Darauf arbeiten wir gemeinsam hin: die erste große Marke für Altenpflege in Europa. Die gibt es bisher nicht.

Wir suchen die Person, die das plant, koordiniert und schreibt. Du denkst dir Kampagnen aus und bringst sie bis zum fertigen Material. Du entscheidest mit, welchen Kanal wir als Nächstes aufmachen und in welcher Reihenfolge. Und du sprichst mit denen, die das möglich machen: Sendern, Veranstaltern, Partnern, Produktionen.

Wenn du es leid bist, deine beste Idee in einer Präsentation sterben zu sehen, ist das hier der Unterschied: keine Pitch-Runden, keine Freigabekette, keine dritte Feedbackschleife. Du stellst deine Idee dem Performance-Marketing und den Gründern vor, und ihr entscheidet im selben Gespräch. Was montags beschlossen wird, läuft spätestens in der Woche darauf.

Wir sind eine der größten Plattformen im deutschen 24-Stunden-Pflegemarkt, finanziert von führenden Investoren wie Capnamic, Almaz Capital, RTL Ventures und Swiss Health Ventures, mit einem bundesweiten Franchise-System und Teams in Berlin, Bonn, Sibiu und Danzig.

Level: Senior. Du planst und koordinierst: Kanäle, Budget, Timing, Briefings. Die Texte schreibst du selbst.

An deiner Seite: unser Senior Performance Marketing Manager. Dort liegen Analyse, Attribution und die Aussteuerung der bezahlten Kanäle. Bei dir liegen Marke, Kampagnen und die Kanäle daneben. Ihr arbeitet auf Augenhöhe an einem Funnel.

Founder-Nähe: du arbeitest eng und direkt mit den Gründern an Marke, Botschaft und Ideen. Kurze Wege, schnelle Entscheidungen.

Perspektive: Head of Brand mit eigenem Team. Die Bedingung dafür sagen wir dir offen: mindestens ein zusätzlicher skalierbarer Push-Kanal, der uns spürbar schneller wachsen lässt.

Start: so bald wie möglich


Deine Rolle in unserem Team

Du bist die erste Person bei marta, die ausschließlich für die Marke da ist. 8 von 10 unserer treuesten Familien würden marta weiterempfehlen. Diese Geschichte erzählt bisher niemand systematisch. Du gibst marta eine Stimme, ein Gesicht und Kampagnen, die hängen bleiben. Was du jetzt festlegst, ist das Fundament für alles, was danach kommt.

Was du machst

  • Kampagnen, die hängen bleiben. Du entwickelst Kampagnen für Familien, die vor einer der schwersten Entscheidungen ihres Lebens stehen. Keine Werbeanzeigen, sondern etwas, das man sich merkt. Und du bringst sie bis zum fertigen Material.
  • Kanäle planen und koordinieren. Du entscheidest mit, was wir als Nächstes testen, in welcher Reihenfolge und mit welchem Erfolgskriterium. Und du sagst genauso klar, was wir uns sparen, weil du Erfahrung mit verschiedenen Kanälen mitbringst.
  • Texte, die du selbst schreibst. Landingpages, SEO- und Ratgeber-Content, Anzeigentexte, E-Mails, Videoskripte, Social, Print. Am Anfang entstehen sie an deinem Schreibtisch, zunehmend KI-gestützt. Wenn ein Kanal skaliert und wir echtes Volumen brauchen, holen wir Unterstützung dazu. 
  • Produktion briefen. Für Film, Design und größere Produktionen arbeitest du mit Freelancern und Spezialisten. Du briefst sie, beurteilst, was zurückkommt, und hältst die Marke über alle Kanäle konsistent.
  • Social Media, UGC und Community. Hinter marta steht eine große Community aus Betreuungskräften. Daraus machst du Formate, Geschichten und nutzergenerierte Inhalte. Unser Ziel: der größte Pflegekanal Deutschlands. 
  • PR und Presse. Du arbeitest mit einer PR-Agentur, schreibst Pressemitteilungen und baust Regionalpresse als Kanal auf.
  • CRM und Lifecycle. Die Entscheidung für eine 24-Stunden-Betreuung zieht sich über Wochen. Willkommensstrecken, Reaktivierung, WhatsApp: die richtige Botschaft zum richtigen Zeitpunkt statt nur Bottom of Funnel. Die Strecken füllst du mit dem richtigen Content und hast ein Auge dafür was funktioniert und was nicht.
  • Botschaft und Tonalität. Du übersetzt unsere fünf Personas in konkrete Botschaften und Touchpoints. Familien entscheiden emotional und nach Qualität, nicht nach Preis. Dein Text muss das treffen.

Dazu kommen die Themen, die du als Erstes in die Hand nimmst: Bewertungen und Google Business Profile, eine Mechanik für Empfehlungen, Regionalpresse und die Sichtbarkeit von marta in der KI-Suche.


So sieht Erfolg aus
Nach 90 Tagen: die erste CRM-Strecke ist live, zwei Kanäle sind erfolgreich angetestet, die ersten Ergebnisse sind vielversprechend, und wir gehen in die Skalierung.
Nach 6 Monaten: die Markenbotschaft steht und ist an allen Kontaktpunkten sichtbar, zwei bis drei eigene Kampagnen sind live, und das Performance-Marketing arbeitet mit frischem Material statt mit denselben drei Anzeigen.
Nach 12 Monaten: marta hat eine Kampagne, die Familien wiedererkennen, der YouTube-Kanal wächst und liefert Material, das in anderen Kanälen weiterläuft, Branded und Direct Traffic steigen, und neue Quellen liefern verlässlich mehr als 3.000 zusätzliche Leads pro Monat..


Das bringst du zu uns mit

Auf diese fünf Punkte schauen wir. Alles danach ist ein Plus und kein Filter.

  • Mindestens 3 Jahre in Marke, Kampagnen oder Content. Agentur oder inhouse, beides passt. Die Jahre sind nicht das Kriterium, die Arbeiten sind es.
  • Arbeiten, die du selbst gemacht hast, nicht nur verantwortet: Texte, Kampagnen, Videos, Seiten. Zwei bis drei davon würden wir gern sehen.
  • Du schreibst sehr gut auf Deutsch (muttersprachliches Niveau, C2) und kannst eine Idee so aufschreiben, dass andere sie umsetzen können.
  • Du hast mindestens einen Kanal außerhalb von Paid Search aufgebaut oder getestet: Mailing, Print, Partnerschaften, Events, Podcast oder TV. Du legst Erfolgskriterien vorher fest und brichst auch mal ab.
  • Du hast mit externen Dienstleistern gearbeitet: auswählen, briefen, Budget führen, Qualität beurteilen.

Das hilft zusätzlich
  • Du hast selbst einmal einen Social-Media-Account aufgebaut und zum Laufen gebracht, beruflich oder privat.
  • Du hast eine Marke mitgestaltet und weißt, wie aus Farben, Designelementen und Sprache ein stimmiges Bild wird.
  • Erfahrung in CRM und Lifecycle (HubSpot, Klaviyo, Superchat oder Vergleichbares).
  • Video und Social sind dir nicht fremd. Du erkennst ein Format, das trägt, und bekommst es auch mit kleinen Mitteln umgesetzt.
  • Erfahrung mit KI-gestützter Content-Produktion und ein klares Urteil, wo sie trägt und wo nicht.
  • Erfahrung mit erklärungsbedürftigen, emotionalen Entscheidungen. Lead-Gen statt reinem E-Commerce.
  • Erfahrung im Verhandeln von Media-, Sponsoring- oder Produktionsbudgets.
  • Englisch C1 für die Zusammenarbeit im Team.
  • Wenn du bei ein oder zwei Punkten unsicher bist: bewirb dich und schreib uns, wie du dir das aneignen würdest. Wir entscheiden nach deinen Erfahrungen und unserem Gespräch, nicht nach einer Checkliste.
Diese Rolle passt nicht, wenn
  • du mit einem Rebranding anfangen willst. Logo und Farben sind nicht unser Engpass. Der Engpass sind Kampagnen und Kanäle.
  • du konzipieren, aber nicht schreiben willst. Am Anfang entstehen die Texte an deinem Schreibtisch.
  • du am liebsten in einer Disziplin bleibst. Dein Feld reicht von der Mailing-Strecke bis zum Gespräch mit einem Sender.
  • du Kreation nach Geschmack beurteilst statt nach Wirkung.
  • du lange Abstimmungsschleifen brauchst. Die Wege sind kurz, dafür entsteht viel in kurzer Zeit.


Warum marta?

  • Virtuelle Unternehmensanteile (VSOP nach Jahr 1) und Performance-Bonus
  • 27 Urlaubstage
  • 2 Tage Homeoffice pro Woche und Vertrauensarbeitszeit
  • Wellhub (Gympass): Zugang zu Fitness, Studios und Wellbeing
  • Ein internationales Team mit Kolleginnen und Kollegen in Berlin, Bonn, Sibiu und Danzig
  • Unser Prozess
  • Fachgespräch, kurze Kampagnenaufgabe, Kennenlernen mit den Gründern, Reference Calls. Wer im Prozess sitzt, sagen wir dir vorher. Entscheidung in der Regel innerhalb von zwei Wochen.

Deine Bewerbung
Schick uns zwei bis drei Projekte, auf die du stolz bist, und in zwei Sätzen, warum. Ein Anschreiben brauchen wir nicht. Schick alles an Wir stehen für Chancengleichheit und freuen uns über Bewerbungen unabhängig von Geschlecht, Alter, Herkunft, Religion, Behinderung oder Lebensweg. Wir bauen bewusst ein Team, das die Familien widerspiegelt, für die wir da sind.

Dann solltest du jetzt weiterlesen!

In unserem Angebot haben wir eine spannende, abwechslungsreiche Stelle als UI / UX Designer im everii Kosmos – mit der Möglichkeit, aktiv die Zukunft eines unserer Kern-Produkte mitzugestalten.

Als UI / UX Designer gestaltest du aktiv die Zukunft von untermStrich, unserer ERP-SaaS-Lösung für Architektur- und Planungsbüros.
Auf Basis von Feature-Konzepten entwirfst du ansprechende UI/UX Designs in Figma – und bringst dabei stets dein eigenes Feedback aus UI/UX Perspektive ein, statt Konzepte nur „blind“ umzusetzen.

Du bist im engen Austausch mit unseren Kunden und Kundenteams, kennst ihre Anforderungen genau und entwickelst unsere Produkte kontinuierlich weiter.

Ein besonderes Highlight: Du begleitest und prägst das Re-Design von untermStrich und gestaltest den Look & Feel aktiv mit.
Das klingt nach dir? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig!
Perfect Match!


Deine Aufgaben

  • UI / UX Designer: Du erstellst auf Basis der Konzepte unseres Produktmanagements Designs für untermStrich, unsere ERP-Lösung für Architektur- und Planungsbüros.
  • UX-Flows gestalten: Du denkst, kreierst und verbesserst UX-Flows und sorgst dafür, dass sich die Software für unsere Kunden intuitiv und stimmig anfühlt.
  • Designsprache weiterentwickeln: Du bringst unsere Designsprache auf das nächste Level.
  • Designumbau unseres Produkts: Aktuell arbeiten wir an einem größeren Designumbau. Du arbeitest hier im absoluten Herzen des Produkts.
  • Regelmäßiger Kundenkontakt: Du bist im ständigen Austausch mit unseren Kunden und Kundenteams, um ihre Anforderungen und Prozesse genau zu kennen.


Dein Profil

  • Erfahrung im UI / UX Design: Du hast bereits im Design für Software-Produkte gearbeitet und kannst mit den gängigen Tools (wir nutzen z. B. Figma und Youtrack) umgehen.
  • AI-Tools im Workflow: Du nutzt KI-Tools selbstverständlich in deinem Design-Alltag, um Prozesse zu beschleunigen und Ideen schneller zu validieren.
  • Erfahrung im B2B Softwarebereich: Du hast dich bereits explizit mit B2B SaaS Software beschäftigt. Begriffe wie MRR, CAC, LTV sind für dich keine Fremdwörter.
  • Trendbewusstsein: Du bringst Drive mit und verfolgst die aktuellen Trends im Bereich Softwaredesign und Gestaltung.
  • Architektur- oder Planungsbüro-Umfeld: Idealerweise hast du Kenntnisse aus dem Architektur-, Ingenieur- oder Planungsbüro-Umfeld, die du im Produktdesign einbringen kannst.
  • Sprachkenntnisse: Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und hast gute Englischkenntnisse für den Austausch mit Kunden und mit unseren Teams.
  • Bonus-Skill: Hast du bereits Erfahrung mit untermStrich oder kennst du die Arbeitswelt von Architektur- und Planungsbüros? Dann ist das ein echtes Plus – aber kein Muss.


Was wir bieten

  • Hybrides Arbeiten mit echtem Spielraum: Top Equipment inklusive. Idealerweise bist du 2–3 Tage pro Woche bei uns im Office, aber wenn mal eine ganze Woche remote passt, ist das kein Problem.
  • Ein kleines, eingespieltes Team: Produkt und Entwicklung arbeiten direkt miteinander. Du bist vom ersten Tag an ein fester Bestandteil des Teams – nicht Zuarbeiter, sondern Mitgestalter.
  • Wachstum, das sich anfühlt: Kein Stillstand. Herausforderungen, die dich fordern, und regelmäßiges Feedback, das dich weiterbringt.
  • Kurze Wege, echte Mitsprache: Flache Hierarchien bedeuten bei uns nicht nur weniger Meetings, sondern auch: deine Perspektive zählt, nicht dein Titel.
  • Ein Team, das sich freut, dich kennenzulernen: Offene Kultur, ehrliche Kommunikation, keine Ellenbogen.
  • Wohlatmosphäre & Team-Kultur: Modernes Büro im Herzen von Hamburg mit frischem Obst, Kaffee, gekühlten Getränken und einem gemeinsamen wöchentlichen Frühstück. 
  • Möglichkeit auf Zuschuss zum Deutschlandticket & Lunch (über EDENRED/Sachbezug).


Kontakinfos

Lust, die Zukunft mitzugestalten?
Dann bewirb dich jetzt mit deinem Lebenslauf, deinem Portfolio und deiner Gehaltsvorstellung – der Start ist ab sofort bzw. zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt möglich!

data.title: Senior Manager Technical Operations (Bauleiter) - Remote (m/w/d)

data.description:
The product you will work on

The HOLOPLOT Matrix Array is a new type of sound system built around precise, software-defined control of sound in three dimensions - grounded in physics and implemented through a combination of custom hardware and purpose-built software. HOLOPLOT deployed Matrix Arrays in various venues, including the Sphere in Las Vegas - the world’s most advanced entertainment venue and, notably, home to the world’s largest audio installation in entertainment. 


Audio processing in HOLOPLOT systems is distributed: every loudspeaker runs embedded Linux, and hundreds of them have to be configured, coordinated, monitored, and updated as one system. This is enabled by multiple open source and in-house developed services running on an on-premises Kubernetes cluster. AWS-hosted services connect venues to remote monitoring, telemetry, and configuration. Many venues are air-gapped or only intermittently connected for remote servicing, and that constraint shapes most of the design decisions in the platform.


The ideal candidate is

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer who builds the platform our sound systems run on, and who takes responsibility for how it behaves in production.


This is a software engineering role first. You will spend your time writing software, either with your own team or embedded with one of the other HOLOPLOT teams: services, controllers, agents, and tooling that provision, configure, observe, and update our systems. Our infrastructure is defined as code and evolves through the same review and release process as the rest of our software. You design the operational side, you build it, and you are on call when it misbehaves in the field.


Your role and responsibilities

You will join the team that owns the platform underneath our installations and connected services, working alongside backend, embedded, and frontend engineers who are organized in cross-functional product teams.


Build the platform

  • Architect and implement services to provision, configure, and manage server fleets across AWS and local clusters.

  • Create control-plane logic for venue systems to ensure consistency, health monitoring, rollout management, and recovery, even during uplink disruptions.

  • Establish end-to-end provisioning workflows for embedded Linux hardware, spanning from initial manufacturing to customer deployment.

  • Enhance update processes to streamline software deployments for active customer installations.

  • Develop APIs and developer tooling that empower engineering teams to independently deploy, observe, and troubleshoot their services.

  • Embed telemetry capabilities into the platform to facilitate remote diagnosis of venue system behavior

  • .

Run what you build

  • Own the AWS infrastructure behind our connected services: remote access, access control, telemetry ingestion, remote backup, secret management, and monitoring. All of it is infrastructure as code.

  • Operate and evolve the on-premises Kubernetes footprint at venues, including air-gapped and intermittently connected installations.

  • Monitor large environments, investigate problems across the software/hardware boundary, and turn each incident into a fix in the code.

  • Be part of a compensated on-call rotation


Set the technical direction

  • Advise and collaborate with product teams on building distributed systems that are scalable, secure, and observable, and review their designs with production reality in mind.

  • Research and introduce tools and technologies where they measurably improve how we build and operate.

  • Contribute back to the open-source projects we depend on, through issues and fixes.


What you need to succeed in this role

  • Several years of professional software engineering experience, most of it spent designing and shipping production systems.

  • Fluency in software engineering as a craft: concurrency, error handling, testing, and designing APIs that other teams build on.

  • Working knowledge of the Kubernetes control plane and the operator/controller pattern, including how clusters behave when they are unhealthy.

  • Hands-on experience with AWS, and a firm belief in infrastructure as code. Terraform and Ansible are what we use today.

  • Comfort across several languages, and the ability to pick up a new one when the problem calls for it. Our platform work is mostly Go and Python, with Rust and C++ elsewhere in the stack.

  • Experience building distributed systems, and a clear understanding of how they fail: partitions, partial rollouts, clock skew, retries, and reconciliation.

  • A good sense for software architecture and maintainability, and the habit of writing code that colleagues can pick up and change.

  • A strong command of Linux, scripting, and automation.

  • Experience instrumenting software for telemetry and using it to answer real questions about running systems.

  • Good judgment about what to automate and what to leave alone.

  • Strong communication skills in English. You can explain a design or a failure clearly to engineers, product stakeholders, and non-specialists.

  • Willingness to take part in compensated on-call and weekend work when installations need it.

  • A can-do mentality, an eye for detail, and the courage to take on problems outside your comfort zone.

  • Experience in using AI for engineering.


Nice to haves

  • Experience with NATS, Prometheus/Thanos, or PostgreSQL in production.

  • Experience with air-gapped or intermittently connected installations.

  • Experience running Kubernetes in production, not only deploying to it.

  • Experience with embedded Linux, device fleet management, or IoT security.

  • Networking depth: multicast at scale, WireGuard, BGP, IPv6.

  • Experience in the audio, broadcast, or live events industry.

  • Contributions to open-source infrastructure projects


We offer you

At HOLOPLOT we work in a flexible hybrid setup with trust-based working hours, giving you the freedom to organise your day in a way that supports focus, deep work and balance. Pay is competitive and fair, and we offer perks and benefits such as subsidised public transport, lunch allowances, Urban Sports and a company pension scheme.

You’ll join an international, open-minded team across software, hardware, product and research, in an environment with plenty of autonomy and ownership. You’ll work on cutting-edge audio technology, turn complex requirements into working solutions and contribute to global projects, with support for your growth through individual development plans, mentoring and coaching.

data.description:
Who we are and what you’ll do

HOLOPLOT is seeking a decisive, technically strong and business-oriented Senior Director Software Engineering (f/m/d), to lead our 20-person software engineering organization, drive cross-functional delivery, and own the long-term software architecture for our high-performance audio products.

Working closely with engineering leads who focus on deep technical problem-solving and team mentorship, this role leads overall software delivery, strategic technical vision, and cross-departmental alignment.


Main objectives of the role

As Senior Director Software Engineering (f/m/d), you will take full technical ownership of the end-to-end delivery of HOLOPLOT’s software ecosystem, spanning embedded and distributed Linux systems, audio DSP, 3D/GPU, C++, Rust and web-based front-end applications, Kubernetes cluster and cloud infrastructure. You will act as the operational bridge between software engineering, hardware development, research, product, customer success teams, and key enterprise clients. You will work closely with the Director of Product for Software as well as the CPO, and report to the CTO.


Your role and responsibilities

  • Strategic Software Vision & Architecture: Own and drive the strategic vision for the technical backbone of the HOLOPLOT product ecosystem. Proactively identify architectural risks and ensure performance and scalability across embedded hardware, audio processing platforms, and user interfaces.

  • Execution & High-Stakes Delivery: Take full accountability for software delivery timeliness, quality, and reliability. Proactively lead critical client-facing missions, OS rollouts, and on-site integration handovers (e.g., venue acceptance testing and integration protocols), including regular international travel

  • High-Performing Mission-Driven Teams: Attract, grow, and retain strong engineering talent to build highly successful, cross-functional product development teams. Foster a culture of excellence, ownership, agency, and innovation that drives high employee engagement, productivity, and strong outcomes for our customers.

  • Cross-Functional Alignment: Drive seamless collaboration between Software, Research, Customer Success, Product Management, and external technical partners (such as client IT security and external system integrators). Eliminate inter-departmental friction and establish clear integration pathways.

  • Business-First Leadership: Together with Product, align software priorities and architecture directly with HOLOPLOT’s strategic and commercial objectives. Make decisive, well-reasoned trade-offs under pressure while optimizing engineering output for maximum company value.

  • Operational Leadership & Partnering: Partner with dedicated Engineering Managers and Tech Leads who oversee team culture, individual mentoring, and deeply technical topics. Foster a culture of engineering excellence, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Focus your impact on operational discipline, accountability, and clear departmental direction.

  • AI Strategy & Development Workflows: Define and execute HOLOPLOT's AI strategy for software development. Integrate AI-assisted engineering tools, automated workflows, and emerging AI technologies into the software development life cycle to elevate team productivity and explore modern product capabilities. 

  • Platform, Quality & Operational Excellence: Ensure high standards of quality, reliability, maintainability, and scalability across all software solutions. Identify, assess, and mitigate technological risks, including technical debt and platform lifecycle challenges. Define and improve engineering processes, development standards, and tooling to enable predictable, high-quality delivery.

  • Security, Compliance & Risk Management: Drive HOLOPLOT’s technology security strategy, including cybersecurity, data protection, and secure-by-design principles. Ensure compliance with relevant industry standards, validation/certifications, and regulatory requirements. Ensure systems are resilient, reliable, and fit for production and customer use.


What you need to succeed in this role

  • Engineering Leadership: Extensive experience managing software teams of significant size (15-30+ engineers) in complex, multi-disciplinary technology environments

  • Deep-Tech Literacy: Comfortable navigating a highly heterogeneous tech stack encompassing Low-Level/Embedded C++ & Rust, Audio DSP, 3D/GPU rendering, Linux, Kubernetes, NATS, gRPC, JUCE, CI/CD and Web services.

  • Track Record of Ownership: Proven experience driving complex hardware-software product rollouts and managing high-stakes client or partner integrations end-to-end.

  • Cross-Functional Stakeholder Management: Strong diplomacy and technical communication skills, with a track record of bridging engineering teams with business, product, research, and client stakeholders.

  • Pragmatic Decision-Making: Ability to operate with high clarity and a steady hand in fast-paced environments, prioritizing long-term product stability over short-term friction.

  • AI-Driven Development Strategy: Demonstrated experience establishing AI-development strategies and driving the practical adoption of AI-assisted software development, LLM tooling, or automated engineering workflows.

data.description:
Intro

Du willst nach dem Studium oder deiner Ausbildung praktisch durchstarten, hast Lust, dich in neue Themen einzuarbeiten, und suchst ein Umfeld, in dem du von Anfang an mit anpackst und wirklich etwas lernst? Dann steig als Trainee Buchhaltung & Office Management (m/w/d) bei uns ein und unterstütze unser Team in Berlin an der Schnittstelle zwischen Buchhaltung, Office Management und CEO Support!Wir empfangen dich in einem Team, das sich gerne neuen Herausforderungen stellt, dich Schritt für Schritt einarbeitet und dir echte Verantwortung überträgt, sobald du dich sicher fühlst.Wir besetzen diese Position zunächst befristet für ein Jahr, da eine Kollegin aus unserem Team für einige Monate eine berufliche Auszeit nimmt. Im Anschluss schauen wir gemeinsam, wie eine langfristige Zusammenarbeit aussehen kann.Idealerweise startest du zum 1. November, damit genug Zeit für eine gute Einarbeitung und Übergabe bleibt.


Deine Aufgaben bei reisetopia

reisetopia ist in den vergangenen Jahren deutlich gewachsen. Als Trainee lernst du dabei nach und nach, worauf es in dieser vielseitigen Position ankommt – ein gutes Auge für Zahlen, Struktur und Prozesse. Du wirst von unserem Team eng begleitet und wächst Schritt für Schritt in folgende Bereiche hinein:

Buchhaltung & Finanzadministration

  • Vorbereitende Buchhaltung: Erfassung, Prüfung und Zuordnung von Belegen in Datev
  • Tägliches Monitoring unserer Bankkonten und Zahlungseingänge sowie Pflege unserer Liquiditätsplanung
  • Erstellung von Rechnungen für Partner sowie Provisionsabrechnungen
  • Übertragung und Aufbereitung der BWA in enger Abstimmung mit unserem CEO
  • Bearbeitung von Reisekostenabrechnungen und Einsammeln von Belegen aus dem Team
Office Management & Unternehmensadministration
  • Organisation von Events und internen Team-Anlässen
  • Verantwortung für Bestellungen (z. B. Büro-/Lebensmittelbestellungen) und allgemeine Maintenance-Themen im Office
  • Pflege interner Unternehmensseiten (u. a. „Über uns", Onboarding- und Mitarbeiterseiten) sowie unserer internen Notion-Wissensdatenbank
  • Sicherstellung regelmäßiger Backups unternehmensrelevanter Daten
  • Weiterentwicklung interner Prozesse und Dokumentationen, damit sich Kolleg:innen im Alltag eigenständig zurechtfinden
CEO Support
  • Ausgefeiltes Kalendermanagement für unseren Geschäftsführer Moritz
  • Vorbereitung von Präsentationen für interne Formate wie unser vierteljährliches Company Update oder Management-Meetings
  • Unterstützung bei allgemeinen Projekten zur Unternehmensentwicklung

Zusätzlich lernst du im Laufe deines Traineeships auch projektbezogene Themen kennen, die für Abwechslung sorgen und dir einen breiten Einblick in die Unternehmensentwicklung geben. Wichtig ist uns vor allem deine Lernbereitschaft – Erfahrung sammelst du bei uns.


Das erwarten wir von Dir

Das zeichnet Dich für diese Position besonders aus:

  • Große Lust, dich schnell und selbstständig in neue Themen einzuarbeiten und stetig dazuzulernen
  • Ein gutes Auge für Zahlen und Daten sowie Freude an Organisation
  • Idealerweise Erfahrung im (Projekt-)Management oder die Fähigkeit, Projekte eigenständig zu strukturieren, zu priorisieren und voranzutreiben
  • Hohe Flexibilität und Belastbarkeit, um Dich in einem dynamischen und wachsenden Umfeld schnell zurechtzufinden
  • Interesse an Buchhaltungs- und Finanzthemen; erste Berührungspunkte (z.B. aus Studium, Ausbildung oder Praktika) sind von Vorteil, aber kein Muss
  • Sicherer Umgang mit Excel; Vorkenntnisse in Datev, Teams und Notion sind ein Plus, aber kein Muss
  • Strukturierte, zuverlässige und diskrete Arbeitsweise – insbesondere im Umgang mit vertraulichen Finanz- und Unternehmensdaten
  • Hervorragende Deutschkenntnisse sowie mindestens gute Englischkenntnisse
  • Wünschenswert: Abgeschlossenes Studium oder abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung (z. B. Bürokauffrau/-mann, Steuerfachangestellte/r) oder vergleichbare Qualifikation
  • Ein zusätzliches Plus: erste Erfahrung in einer Assistenz-, Buchhaltungs- oder Office-Management-Rolle sowie Interesse an Finanzen und (Luxus-)Reisen

Grundlegend für alle Stellen gilt bei uns ein Fokus auf Teamarbeit, Spaß an der Sache und Proaktivität. Wir schätzen neue Ideen und fordern Dich bei Deiner Arbeit täglich heraus.


Das erwartet Dich bei reisetopia

Inmitten der Hauptstadtmetropole bieten wir Dir ein junges und agiles Arbeitsumfeld. Als Kernelemente der DNA von reisetopia gestalten flexible Arbeitszeiten und Optionen für Home oder Travel Office den Arbeitsalltag besonders dynamisch.

Für diese Position liegt das Jahresgehalt zwischen 30.000,00 Euro und 35.000,00 Euro brutto, abhängig von Deiner Erfahrung und Qualifikation. Die Stelle ist dem Junior-Level zugeordnet.

Wir bieten eine Menge für deinen Einsatz - von einmaligen Teamtrips und außergewöhnlichen Teamevents bis hin zu einmaligen Aufstiegsmöglichkeiten in einem rasant wachsendem Unternehmen. Wir empfangen Dich in einer familiären Atmosphäre und bieten eine ganze Reihe an Add-ons, die Deinen Arbeitsalltag verschönern:

  • Beste Arbeitsbedingungen in unserem Büro in der Nähe vom am Potsdamer Platz
  • Deutschlandticket Job oder Job Rad
  • Mittagsessenzuschuss und monatliches Catering
  • Interne und externe Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten in Höhe von 500 Euro im Jahr
  • Kostenfreier Barista-Kaffee sowie verschiedene Kaltgetränke
  • Snacks und frisches Obst
  • Flache Hierarchien und kurze Entscheidungswege
  • Möglichkeiten eigene Projekte umzusetzen
  • Cashback für Buchung über suitespot
  • Moderne und einfache Zeiterfassung mit voller Flexibilität
  • Aktive Unterstützung durch kostenlose und anonyme Coachings zur Verbesserung der mentalen Gesundheit
  • Zuschuss zu Deiner Urban Sports Club-Mitgliedschaft
  • Exklusive Mitarbeiterrabatte für Shopping, Reisen und vieles mehr
Damit Du unser Produkt auch persönlich kennenlernst, gibt es für Dich zusätzlich zum Start ein kostenloses Wochenende mit reisetopia Hotels Vorteilen im Waldorf Astoria Berlin!

Deine Aufgaben

Als Team Lead Lead Development Product übernimmst du die fachliche und disziplinarische Führung unseres Lead-Development-Teams im Product-Umfeld. In deiner Rolle verbindest du People Leadership mit technischer und operativer Steuerung. Du schaffst Transparenz über laufende Themen, Kapazitäten, Risiken und Prioritäten, entwickelst dein Team weiter und stellst klare Arbeitsweisen und Qualitätsstandards sicher.
Ein besonderer Fokus liegt auf der Nähe zu unserem Produkt: Du behältst technische Konsistenz, Standardnähe und Wiederverwendbarkeit im Blick und sorgst dafür, dass Erfahrungen und Anforderungen aus Projekten sinnvoll in die Weiterentwicklung von APplus einfließen.
